evidence.gameAssetInterpretation: User-selected field maple analogue for NA_LondonPlaneTree01; game species identity is unverified.
evidence.foliage: Deciduous broadleaf with a compact, dense, irregular crown.
evidence.publishedSizeContext: Nursery guidance gives circa 12 m height and 7–8 m width; RHS separately describes height over 12 m and spread 4–8 m. The 10 m model is an explicit adaptation, not a published species limit.

modelAdaptation.label: Compact field maple
modelAdaptation.basis: User-requested 10 m interpretation; 8 m crown approximates the measured mesh and published spread. Spacing is a provisional planting target, not a measured biological requirement.

evidence.soil: Moist, well-drained; chalk, clay, loam or sand.
evidence.rhsHardiness: H6; not a temperature suitability curve

quantitativeShadeEvidence.note: Runtime 60/50 remain provisional model inputs, not measured field-maple percentages.

evidence.estimates: 10 m height is a user-requested compact model. The 8 m crown and 8 m spacing are modelling choices. Temperature/slope curves and elevation limits remain uncalibrated prototype values; they are not field-maple survival thresholds. Native CS2 controls aging and survival. Existing saved profiles are not rewritten.
